---
title: "Concepts"
---

The lake looks like an ordinary set of tables. What makes a query against it
right or wrong is a handful of ideas that don't show up in any single column
name:

- [**Three time axes**](time-axes.qmd) — the period a number describes, the
  release that published it, and the catalog release that first carried it,
  are three different things and only one of them is usually what you meant
  to filter on.
- [**Suppression is a status**](suppression.qmd) — a missing cell is never a
  blank `value`; it's a documented reason, and the invariant is enforced,
  not just intended.
- [**Boundary vintages**](boundaries.qmd) — county and tract boundaries
  change. A FIPS code without a vintage is an assembly name without a patch
  level.
- [**The licence gate**](licence-gate.qmd) — what's excluded from a
  source, and why, decided before ingest, not discovered by a user later.
- [**Catchment Lake and Cancer InFocus**](cancer-infocus.qmd) — upstream,
  not a competitor.
